_note: IOT_URL points to the metered IoT device (sessions) — it only says WHERE the agent sends requests; it is not an identity (see ../../docs/IDENTITY.md §1).
_note_hostname: A hostname is recommended instead of an IP address (e.g. http://iot.your-domain.si:3200): when the device's IP changes, the configuration does not need to change. The value can also be set with the IOT_URL environment variable, which takes precedence over this file: IOT_URL=http://iot.your-domain.si:3200 npm run mock
_note_wireshark: For capture in Wireshark use http:// (without TLS). The session identity is the wallet + EIP-191 signature, not the IP address — the session therefore survives a network change.
